description.p: This is a community package of Hypersomnia, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream Linux AppImage unmodified: the game is installed from Hypersomnia's own download and receives new versions through Flatpak updates.

Hypersomnia is a free, open-source multiplayer top-down shooter with the tactics of Counter-Strike, the pace of Hotline Miami and pixel-art visuals. Fight duels or clan wars across 24 firearms and two game modes, bomb defusal and gun game, on official and community maps. It is written in C++ without a game engine, and its simulation is deterministic across Linux, Windows, macOS and the browser, so native and browser players share the same servers.

ul.li: Online multiplayer: the server browser, quick play, hosting your own game, and the master server
An in-game WYSIWYG map editor that can playtest a work-in-progress map with friends in one click
The tutorial and single-player practice range
Dedicated-server and tournament tools embedded in the same executable

description.p: The launcher disables the game's update check. Settings, keys, logs, demos, editor projects and downloaded maps are stored in ~/.var/app/io.hypersomnia.Hypersomnia/config/Hypersomnia.
